name: Carrie - AI Therapy In Your Pocket
tagline: A video-call AI companion that reads facial emotion and adjusts how it talks to you.
problem: Therapy is expensive and scarce while burnout grows, the team says.
solution: Webcam frames every two seconds feed a vision-transformer emotion classifier; the conversation adapts its tone; voice runs through ElevenLabs over a live video call.
demo_moment: Team-described: look sad and hear the companion respond gently.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 217 submissions.
Adapts to detected emotion, not only to words.

lessons: A second signal beyond text makes a companion demo feel attentive.
